notes: CIMET supplied no check-library export, only a redacted call transcript. Every approved text
below is quoted from what the real agent actually says in that transcript, lightly cleaned of
transcription artefacts (run-together words, filler 'K?'). See DECISIONS D19.
The transcript is gitignored. Only these extracted approved phrasings are tracked, and they
contain no customer detail: every identifier in the source is already a placeholder tag.

checks.title: Recording disclaimer given
checks.approved_text: please be advised that this call will be recorded for quality assurance and training purposes
checks.speaker: agent

ordering.description: The disclaimer must be spoken before any personal detail is collected or confirmed.

checks.reason_pass: Recording disclaimer given before any personal data was collected.
checks.reason_fail: Recording disclaimer missing, or given after personal data had already been collected.
checks.source_note: In the source call the agent confirms the service address twice before giving the disclaimer, so the real call fails this ordering rule.

checks.title: Account holder confirmed

can you please verify again your first and last name as per id please

checks.reason_fail: Agent never confirmed the account holder.

checks.title: Plan key information read
checks.approved_text: this value plan comes with a month to month contract only and provides twenty five Mbps typical download speed and eight point five Mbps typical upload speed from seven PM to eleven PM. The original plan cost is seventy two dollars and ninety per month, but we have an offer ongoing where you will get this plan at forty two dollars and ninety per month for the first six months and then seventy two dollars and ninety. The modem that you will receive is the Netcomm CF forty Wi-Fi six modem, it is one hundred percent free, no extra cost
checks.speaker: agent
checks.reason_pass: Agent read the plan key information block.
checks.reason_fail: Plan key information was not read, or differed materially from the approved wording.

checks.title: Total minimum cost disclosed
checks.approved_text: the total minimum cost will be forty two dollars and ninety only, no setup fee, no any additional cost
checks.speaker: agent
checks.reason_pass: Agent disclosed the total minimum cost with no setup or additional fees.
checks.reason_fail: Total minimum cost was never disclosed.

checks.title: Explicit informed consent to switch
checks.approved_text: do you understand and agree to switch your internet service to this plan on these terms
checks.speaker: agent
checks.reason_pass: Agent obtained explicit spoken consent to switch.
checks.reason_fail: No explicit spoken consent to switch was obtained.
checks.source_note: The source call contains no explicit consent question. The customer consents by ticking boxes and submitting the web form, so the agent never asks for spoken agreement. This check is written as the control that absence implies, not quoted from the transcript, and the source call FAILS it. Flagged because it is the one Type A check here whose approved text is not verbatim from the handout.
